name: llama.cpp Router
short_desc: Local LLM server (router mode) with multi-model hot-swap and idle unload
author: ggml-org
description: llama-server running in router mode with hot-swappable models and automatic unload after idle (--sleep-idle-seconds). Exposes an OpenAI-compatible API consumed by LiteLLM. Ships with presets for GLM-4.7-Flash (30B-A3B) and Gemma 4 26B-A4B — both MoE with expert offloading to RAM.

form_fields.label: Models directory (host path)
form_fields.hint: Absolute host path containing the GGUF files (e.g. /home/romain/models)

form_fields.label: Sleep idle seconds
form_fields.hint: Unload model after N seconds of inactivity (-1 disables)

form_fields.label: Max loaded models
form_fields.hint: Max models held simultaneously. Keep at 1 unless you have lots of memory.
